text: After you have soaked at least one pack of the test cigarettes, fill out this questionnaire.
instructions: INSTRUCTIONS: After you have soaked at least one pack of the test cigarettes, fill out this questionnaire. Each question has two parts. The first part asks about the first cigarette and the second part about the last cigarette. Be sure to read each set of questions carefully and circle the answer that best describes how you felt about the cigarettes.
